text: Marine and ecology conditions of the EIA: no marine works outside the window of DP-EPCE-0014; a fish return system at the screens with the intake velocity of DP-EPCE-0011; archaeological chance-find procedure for all excavations; construction noisy works only on weekdays 07:00 to 19:00 and Saturdays 08:00 to 17:00 with 7 days notice for steam blowing and silencers; traffic restrictions of the village road; each condition shall be entered in the EIA compliance matrix HS-RPT-0001 with the measure and the evidence document.
